summary.text: One of Penelope's suitors in Apollodorus' catalogue of the fifty-seven wooers from Dulichium — attested only among the wooers who came against Odysseus' house, distinct from later historical and mythic Antigonuses.

story.text: Apollodorus names Antigonus among the suitors who devoured Odysseus' substance, listed after Schedius and before Marpsius in the long company of Penelope's wooers.
